text: Chigorodó is a town and municipality located in the Antioquia Department of Colombia, within the Urabá Antioquia sub-region. It is served by the Jaime Ortiz Betancur Airport, which previously offered commercial air service to Medellín operated by ACES Colombia Airlines during the early 1990s. The town has a tropical rainforest climate classified as Af, characterized by heavy to very heavy rainfall throughout the year. Its geographic coordinates are 7°40′03″N 76°40′51″W, or 7.66750°N 76.68083°W.
